content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Gumroad, a popular platform for selling digital products, charges a whopping 10% commission on every sale, making it a significant barrier for creators looking to maximize their earnings. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a flat 0.5% fee, making it an attractive option for those seeking to minimize transaction costs. Additionally, NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack, providing a streamlined payment experience for your customers. When it comes to payment gateways, the choice is clear: NOWPayments is the superior option for digital sellers seeking to boost their revenue and simplify their payment processes.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

While Stripe and PayPal have imposed restrictions on certain countries, NOWPayments has taken a different approach, ensuring that its services remain accessible to digital sellers worldwide, including those in restricted countries like Zimbabwe. This means that you can continue to sell your digital products and reach a global audience without worrying about KYC regulations or restrictions. With NOWPayments, you can confidently expand your customer base and grow your business without the burden of intermediaries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments can net you a staggering $921. This is not just a theoretical benefit; it's a tangible advantage that can make a significant impact on your business. Moreover, NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, eliminating the need for manual processing and reducing transaction times. With NOWPayments, you can enjoy faster payment processing, lower fees, and greater control over your finances.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of NOWPayments is its focus on infrastructure sovereignty, allowing you to own and control your payment infrastructure, free from intermediaries. With the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack, you can automate delivery of your digital products, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers. Additionally, NOWPayments integrates with Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script, enabling you to automate backend logic and streamline your operations. By choosing NOWPayments, you can maintain ownership and control over your business, empowering you to scale and grow with confidence.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice between NOWPayments and other payment gateways depends on your specific needs and goals. If you're looking to minimize transaction costs, simplify payment processes, and expand your customer base, NOWPayments is the clear choice. However, if you're seeking a more comprehensive solution that includes infrastructure sovereignty, automation, and delivery, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers a more complete package. Regardless of your choice, it's essential to prioritize your sovereignty and choose a payment infrastructure that aligns with your business goals.
